en: The black-and-white image depicts the interior of a small post office. A woman sits behind a counter with a telephone. The wall behind her displays posters, and there is a sign that says 'POST.' There is a mail slot on the front of the counter. The setting appears modest and functional, with large windows letting in daylight and a view outside showing a fence or building.
